prompt: A wide street of low brick apartment buildings in warm late-afternoon light, the road filled with a crowd of neighbours of all ages standing together, front doors open behind them. Small deep red (#9E1A14) ribbons are tied to light poles and porch rails. People hug and talk quietly, seen from a raised angle at the end of the block, long golden shadows across the asphalt. Semi-realistic painted graphic-novel comic art with heavy dark ink linework, diagonal hatching in the shadows and crosshatching in the deepest shadows, realistic painted shading and muted desaturated colour. An ordinary present-day American city. Every sign, screen and surface is blank and plain.
